en.text:
Base Grenade Cooldown is set to 121 seconds while equipped.

Holding [Grenade] charges your grenade and converts it into a throwable <stasis/>'Stasis Turret' that targets enemies within a 35 meter radius.

<stasis/>Stasis Turret fires a burst of 5 seeking projectiles over 0.7 seconds every 2 seconds. Each projectile applies <pve x20 /> <pvp [x10] /> <stasis/>Slow for <pve 4.5 /> <pvp [2] /> seconds on hit (<pve 9 /> <pvp [3.75] /> seconds with <stasis/>Whisper of Durance).

Turret lasts for 25 seconds (30 seconds with <stasis/>Whisper of Durance) and has 67% Damage Resistance until it has fired.

<stasis/>Stasis Turret counts as a Grenade Ability and is buffed by, and triggers, grenade-specific effects.
